chunks: Whoever departs from Makkah while not intending to return to it, then his term has drawn near and his punishment has approached.

key_terms.عَذَابُهُ: his punishment, referring to divine chastisement
key_terms.لَا يَنْوِي: does not intend, indicating one's inward resolve
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sacred city and center of hajj

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about leaving Makkah without intending to return?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against leaving Makkah with no intention of returning, presenting it as a grave spiritual matter. It links such a departure to the nearness of death and punishment, emphasizing the sanctity and religious importance of Makkah.
